title: group
body:
## group

Combines several input nodes into one multiblock (composite) dataset, one block per input in connection order, without changing the data. Use it to process, colour or export several parts together while keeping them distinct; use append or merge when you need a single mesh.

Common mistakes and assumptions:

- Filters that need a non-composite input will not accept the grouped result; merge it first.

Native constructor: `GroupDatasets`. Identity: `curated binding`. Role: `pipeline`. Output kinds: `["data"]`.

### Inputs

| Port | Meaning / native port | Required | Multiplicity | Kind | Contract |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `input` | Required data input list for the native Input port. List each upstream node to connect; each entry is a node name or a {node, port} object. Accepted data: any data object (vtkDataObject); hyper-tree grids (adaptive AMR-like trees) (vtkHyperTreeGrid). | True | nonempty list | `data` | `{"compatibility":"native-domain-checked","composite":true,"cost":{"basis":"no benchmark","conversion":"none inserted","rating":"unknown"},"nativeTypes":["vtkDataObject","vtkHyperTreeGrid"],"requirements":{},"traits":{"contiguity":"unknown","indexing":"unknown","iteration":"unknown"}}` |

### Options

| Key | Meaning / native assignment | Type and constraints | Default / required | Example value |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `names` | Specify names to use for each input. | `{"type":"array","items":{"type":"string","minLength":1},"minItems":1}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `["REPLACE_WITH_VALUE"]` |

Execution contract:

```json
{
  "mode": "serial",
  "performance": "unknown"
}
```

### Syntax example

Place in `nodes`. Data outputs may be selected by a scene; resource outputs must be connected to a compatible consumer.

```json
{
  "id": "result",
  "filter": "group",
  "inputs": {
    "input": [
      "UPSTREAM_input"
    ]
  }
}
```
